newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bnk E.Asia says 1997 HK banking outlook optimistic.
newsitem.headline: Bnk E.Asia says 1997 HK banking outlook optimistic.

text.p: Bank of East Asia Ltd said the outlook for the Hong Kong banking sector remained optimistic in 1997.
"Anticipated further improvement in the Hong Kong economy should stimulate stronger credit demand, especially in retail, property and construction financing," it said in a statement.
Funding costs would be kept at a "comfortable level" due to a relatively stable interest rate environment expected in the United States, it added.
"Hence, the banking sector is likely to continue to perform well in 1997," it said.
Bank of East Asia posted a 14.5 percent rise in net profit for 1996 to HK$1.88 billion.
